info.name: Taajir Inventory API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Taajir FastAPI backend.

### Authentication
- Tenant endpoints (`/v1/inventories`, `/v1/invoices`, `/v1/parties`, `/v1/reports`, `/v1/widgets`) require:
  - `Authorization: Bearer <supabase_access_token>` (collection-level Bearer auth, `bearerToken` variable)
  - `X-Organization-ID: <organization_uuid>` (`organizationId` variable)
- Admin endpoints (`/v1/admin/organizations`) require `X-Admin-Token: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>` (`adminToken` variable).
- Health endpoints need no authentication.

### Variables
Set `baseUrl`, `bearerToken`, `organizationId` and `adminToken` in the environment. The list requests save `inventoryId`, `partyId`, `invoiceId` and `branchId` automatically for use by detail requests.

Default base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Hosted: `https://api.taajir.app` (prod) or `https://api.dev.taajir.app` (dev).

item.name: Inventories

request.description: Paginated inventory table. `search` matches name, barcode or serial; `export=true` ignores limit and includes serials.
Aggregated stock totals: in stock, sold, incoming, outgoing, purchased, returned, transferred out.
Invoices that include the given inventory item, with optional type/status/date filters.
Audit trail entries for the given inventory item.
Inbound/outbound/transfer/adjustment movements for the given inventory item.
Serial numbers tracked for the given inventory item.

item.description: Inventory list, stock summary, invoice history, audit logs, movements and serials.

item.name: Invoices

query.description: created_at, total_price, total_due, total_paid, party_name, payment_status

request.description: Paginated invoice list. Profit is only returned when the caller has the `reports` module permission.
Line items (inventory, quantity, prices, discounts, serials) for one invoice.

item.description: Customer/supplier invoice list and line items.

item.name: Parties

request.description: Paginated customers/suppliers with invoice totals, paid totals, dues and opening balance.
Chronological debit/credit ledger for a party.
Returns the stored opening balance for a party and invoice type.
Creates or updates a party opening balance. `amount` is signed: positive means the party owes you (or you owe the supplier); negative means an advance.
Records an on-account payment against a party (not tied to a single invoice). `amount` is a positive magnitude.

item.description: Customers and suppliers: list, ledger, opening balances and on-account payments.

item.name: Reports

request.description: Per-product purchased/sold quantities, revenue, profit and net income.
Revenue, expense, profit, COGS and quantity breakdown, grouped by day/week/month.
Per-category stock and revenue/profit figures.

query.description: total-invoices, total-revenue, total-paid, total-discount or average

request.description: Invoice and revenue performance grouped by sales person.
Inventory adjustment history.
Stock transfer history between branches/warehouses, including totals.
Daily revenue/expense/profit totals. Defaults to today when dates are omitted.

query.description: total-amount, total-paid, total-due, total-products or total-invoices

request.description: Supplier purchase totals and invoice counts.
Products purchased from one supplier, with total amount.

query.description: total-amount, total-paid, total-due, total-products, total-invoices or total-profit

request.description: Customer sales totals, dues and profit.
Products sold to one customer, with total amount and profit.

item.description: Analytics and reporting endpoints. All support optional date/branch filtering.

item.name: Widgets

request.description: Today/month expenses and revenue, stock in/out, stock and retail valuation, supplier and customer dues.
Top categories ranked by profit.
Average sales per day of week.
Items at or below their low-stock threshold.
Monthly transaction totals for the breakdown chart.
Outstanding customer/supplier invoices, paginated by page number.
Most recent transactions for the activity feed.
